_comment: TD-105 build (2026-08-22) pinned panel for the whatsapp_endpoints_blocked_count/whatsapp_endpoints_dns_inconsistent_count removal. Ground truth is OONI's own /api/v1/measurements API for every row -- unlike the fixture's earlier bug-(b) entry (still present in tests/fixtures/ooni_whatsapp_web_accessible_classification/pinned_measurements.json, now reclassified), this fixture only exists post-fix, so there is no CLIO-logic-as-ground-truth exception needed here. All 5 rows were fetched live and cross-checked against int.ooni_measurement_verdicts_candidate during the build session.

entries.note: Reclassified, low blocked_count bucket: whatsapp_endpoints_blocked_count=2, whatsapp_web_accessible=TRUE, registration_server_status='ok' -- blocked_count was the sole driver. OONI's own live API confirms OK (anomaly=false, scores.analysis.whatsapp_endpoints_accessible=true).

Reclassified, highest blocked_count observed anywhere in the population (=15), sole driver otherwise clean. OONI's own live API confirms OK (anomaly=false, scores.analysis.whatsapp_endpoints_accessible=true) -- direct evidence the condition carried no real signal even at its most extreme observed value.

Regression guard: whatsapp_endpoints_blocked_count=7 (>0, would have independently triggered the old rule) AND whatsapp_web_accessible=FALSE (bug (a)'s untouched condition, the real driver). Must stay ANOMALOUS after removing blocked_count from the OR-chain. OONI's own live API confirms ANOMALOUS (anomaly=true) with no `analysis` key present -- branch precedence: OONI's own scorer never reached the endpoint-accessibility check here either, consistent with the web check already having failed.

Regression guard: whatsapp_endpoints_blocked_count=4 (>0) AND registration_server_status='blocked' (bug (c)'s untouched condition, the real driver). Must stay ANOMALOUS after removing blocked_count from the OR-chain. OONI's own live API confirms ANOMALOUS (anomaly=true) with no `analysis` key present -- same branch-precedence mechanism as the row above, this time via the registration-server check failing first.

Regression guard, unrelated to this fix: whatsapp_endpoints_blocked_count=0, no OR-chain condition true before or after. OONI's own live API confirms OK. Proves the fix does not touch rows that were never affected by blocked_count in the first place.
